resources.string: Recognise a downloaded voice message on this device. No Premium or audio upload. The result may contain errors. Up to three minutes; cancellation is available.
Choose the recording language to start.
Download the multilingual speech model (78 MB) once. Later recognition works offline. Mobile data charges from your carrier may apply.
Could not recognise this audio. Check that it is downloaded and no longer than three minutes. Encrypted cache files and unsupported audio formats are not supported in this version.
